buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Accounts Officer (WORKS)/PLG/KTD, BSNL payable at Kolkata . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of Accounts Officer (WORKS)/PLG/KTD, BSNL payable at Kolkata . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name Accounts Officer (WORKS)/PLG/KTD, BSNL Account No. 11108915982 IFSC Code SBIN0001139 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address P-15, India Exchange Place Extn, Todi Mansion, 1st Floor, Kolkata 700073 . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder should carefully note and accept following: 1. The bidder must submit all the required documents as mentioned in SECTION-XII of the “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” document. 2. The bidder shall submit all the declarations and annexures as required in the terms mentioned in “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” as well as Bid document duly signed with date & stamp. 3. The bidder should upload the scanned copies from original documents ONLY as mentioned in the Bid & annexures during online bid submission. 4. In case, at any stage, the declarations & annexures submitted by the bidder are found to be fals e or incorrect, the BSNL shall be free to take any punitive/legal action against the company, as ma y be deemed fit, which shall be acceptable/binding on the company leading to cancellation of the c ontract. 5. The bidder should accept all the terms & conditions mentioned in the GeM bid document as we ll as the “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” document. 6. The successful selected vendors should accept and process the GeM Contract within 3 days of is sue of the GeM Contract by the buyer. Without acceptance of the GeM Contract by the seller within the stipulated time, the GeM Contract will be cancelled by the buyer without any further intimation . 7. The successful selected vendors must comply with the Tender Technical Specifications and all th e terms & conditions mentioned in the GeM bid document, Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC as well as the GeM Contract. No deviations shall be entertained unless specifically mentioned. 8. The successful selected bidders shall submit Performance Security in the form of ePBG ONLY within 15 days from the date of issue of the GeM Contract as mentioned in SECTION-V Clause 5 (i) of the “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” document. BG issuing bank must send the BG advice via SFMS (Structural Financial Messaging System) as provided by RBI. Duration of ePBG vali dity, amount and beneficiary are mentioned in the GeM bid document. Format of the ePBG shall be automatically provided by the GeM portal itself upon award of the GeM Contract. 9. The successful selected bidders shall also submit an additional Material Security in the form of Bank Guarantee within 15 days from the date of issue of the GeM Contract as mentioned in SEC TION-V Clause 5(ii) of the “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” document. The format for Materia l Security Bond is provided in SECTION-X of the “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” document. 10. BSNL shall not be liable to pay any interest on any of the BGs mentioned above. 11. Invoice to be raised in the name of Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited. GSTIN: 19AABCB5576G3ZG. The tax invoice date and date of tax invoice submission shall not exceed 7 days under any circums tances. 12. Currently, there is no payment method under TReDS (Trade Receivables Discounting System) is being followed by BSNL. Hence, for submission of Invoice(s)/Bill(s) by successful vendor, kindly ref er to Payment Terms document for further details. 13. Tax Indemnity Clause: BSNL has the right to recover from the supplier any Input Tax Credit loss suffered by it due to any mis-declaration on invoice by the supplier. Also, the supplier must have G ST registration for the tendered service mentioned in the item category. . 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
